message:
Evaluate Attention controls on EDA server with DC VCS and PrimeTime

Run 8 SS100MHz fixed tops, 116 oracle-checked RTL/mapped replays (230400 cycles), 66 averaged power windows and 8-top timing diagnostics. Report raw and 0.81-scaled area separately. Preserve hold violations and PWR-981 warnings; no timing signoff or complete Attention energy claim. Fix DC2018 declaration ordering without changing equations, preserve failed snapshots, archive originals privately, and register the new run.

Refs #198
